modes.note: Whole dedicated Mac (Netherlands), full root, unlimited traffic (fair use), public IPv4 + IPv6, remote reboot. EUR excl. VAT x 1.17. Delivery from <24 h to ~7 business days depending on config.
modes.commit_term: 1-year for the €74/month M4 rate; billing term for other portal rows is not stated

free.conditions: No automatic free tier. No-commitment paid plans may be tested without a long contract; a test machine can be requested from sales for a specific use case. Eligible established OSI-licensed FOSS projects can apply for a free dedicated Mac.

Apple macOS SLA: leasing a Mac requires a minimum lease of 24 consecutive hours with sole use by the lessee, and allows at most 2 additional macOS VMs per Mac.

fleet.verification: Order form collects customer/company details; availability confirmed after account setup and billing verification.
fleet.notes: Chrome-rendered ordering portal publishes Mac configurations, not a numerical new-account concurrent-device cap or quota-increase policy. Fleet requires inventory and billing confirmation; no review SLA established. Portal lists 17 currently available configurations (96 total); fleets above 10 servers are eligible for a custom sales offer; no hard account quota is published.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Important: we do not back up your data. Unless specifically agreed otherwise, backing up your Mac server is your responsibility.
snapshot_auto.note: Bare-metal Mac minis/Studios, 'fully dedicated with no virtualisation involved' (products page), no sleep/pause lifecycle; machine state just persists on its own SSD.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: The GMH Portal API gives you programmatic access to your servers, invoices, team members, and power controls.
snapshot_on_demand.note: No snapshot/image product in portal or API (endpoints: invoices, services get/patch, power reboot/power_on/power_off, team, tokens). Backups are customer-run (Time Machine / Carbon Copy Cloner to a provider-attached USB drive, Arq/restic off-site); bootable clones not reliable on Apple Silicon per the backup article. No boot-new-machine-from-image.

harness_api.quote: The GMH Portal API gives you programmatic access to your servers, invoices, team members, and power controls.
harness_api.note: Beta Customer API (portal.greenmini.host/api/v1) only does power actions, service metadata, invoices, team and tokens. No exec or agent-harness API.

ingress_rules.quote: We offer this as an add-on for customers who want their Mac (or fleet of Macs) behind a managed stateful firewall on an isolated private VLAN, with public traffic reaching them only through defined rules.
ingress_rules.note: Default is fully open: 'Short answer: all of them, by default. Your Mac gets a public IP with no filtering at our network, except for a small set of ports known to be abused for DDoS attacks' (UDP amplification ports, inbound UDP 5353 blocked). Provider-side ingress control only via the paid managed firewall add-on (contact sales); no self-service security groups/API.

guest_firewall.quote: PF (Packet Filter). This is the real firewall, inherited from OpenBSD. It works at the network level: filter by port, protocol, source/destination IP, and more.
guest_firewall.note: macOS pf (pfctl, /etc/pf.conf, or the Murus GUI) with full admin/root on bare metal; the guide covers inbound rules, persistence across reboots and lock-out rollback. Not nftables/iptables since it is macOS.

secret_proxy.quote: The GMH Portal API gives you programmatic access to your servers, invoices, team members, and power controls.
secret_proxy.note: No credential-injection/secrets product anywhere in the docs; secrets on a dedicated Mac are entirely the customer's own responsibility, same conclusion already recorded in the card's feature_evidence.

isolation.quote: What you actually get ✓ A whole dedicated, physical, bare metal Mac

image_oci.quote: From a single hosted Mac mini to a complete CI/CD Cloud - you are on the right address
image_oci.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a whole physical Mac you install macOS software on yourself, not an OCI/Docker image-boot platform.

docker_inside.note: derived: full root on a bare-metal Apple Silicon Mac with nested virtualization available (card features.nested_virt=true), so Docker Desktop (Apple Virtualization Framework) can run; not explicitly documented by the provider.

anti_bot.quote: From a single hosted Mac mini to a complete CI/CD Cloud - you are on the right address
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — dedicated Mac hosting infrastructure, not a browser/scraping product.

captcha_solving.quote: From a single hosted Mac mini to a complete CI/CD Cloud - you are on the right address
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — plain dedicated Mac hosting, not a CAPTCHA/automation service.

egress_ip_type.quote: Short answer: all of them, by default. Your Mac gets a public IP with no filtering at our network
egress_ip_type.note: Dedicated Mac has its own fixed public IPv4 in the provider's EU data center (card features.static_egress_ip=true); a datacenter IP, not residential/mobile.

volume_attach.quote: We can connect a 2.5" USB drive to your Mac for a one-time purchase fee, no recurring costs. Just open a ticket or email support@greenmini.nl and let us know what size you need (2TB, 4TB, 8TB+).
volume_attach.note: Extra persistent storage is attachable but via a support ticket/physical USB drive, not a self-service API-driven 'volume' product.

volume_shared.quote: We can connect a 2.5" USB drive to your Mac for a one-time purchase fee, no recurring costs.
volume_shared.note: not offered: an attached USB drive is per-Mac local storage, not a volume mountable by several running machines at once.

live_resize.quote: Mac mini M4 - Base Apple Silicon M4 10-Core CPU / 10-Core GPU 16-32GB RAM 256GB SSD
live_resize.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — each plan is a fixed physical Mac configuration; changing CPU/RAM means switching to a different physical machine, not a live resize of a running one.

own_agent_api.quote: The GMH Portal API gives you programmatic access to your servers, invoices, team members, and power controls.
own_agent_api.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the Customer API only does power actions/service metadata/invoices/team/tokens; no browser/computer-use/research task-agent API exists on top of a plain Mac host.

mcp_server.quote: The GMH Portal API gives you programmatic access to your servers, invoices, team members, and power controls.
mcp_server.note: No MCP server found in docs/help center/API reference; only a REST Customer API for power/billing/team.

lang_python.quote: Handy guides to get started using your hosted Mac as a Service quickly
lang_python.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a bare macOS host you configure yourself; getting-started/best-practices guides cover OS/power/network settings only, no bundled language runtime or code-exec SDK is documented.

lang_node.quote: Handy guides to get started using your hosted Mac as a Service quickly
lang_node.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — same as lang_python; no bundled Node.js runtime or SDK code-exec is documented, you install your own software with full root.

egress_allowlist.quote: Dedicated firewall and private network isolation. We offer this as an add-on for customers who want their Mac (or fleet of Macs) behind a managed stateful firewall on an isolated private VLAN, with public traffic reaching them only through defined rules.
egress_allowlist.note: No self-service provider-side outbound allow/deny list; the paid managed firewall/VLAN add-on and the guest pf firewall (card features.guest_firewall=true) are the only filtering mechanisms, and both are framed around inbound traffic, not a distinct egress allowlist product.

egress_http_rules.quote: From a single hosted Mac mini to a complete CI/CD Cloud - you are on the right address
egress_http_rules.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a bare-metal Mac host with a network-level pf/managed firewall has no HTTP method/path-level egress rule feature.

hipaa.quote: 100% EU-based and EU-owned ... Green Mini host is a Dutch company, and our data centers are located in The Netherlands as well.
hipaa.note: not offered: no HIPAA/BAA mention anywhere on the security/privacy or legal-documents pages; the compliance framing is entirely EU/GDPR-focused (ISO27001), consistent with a Netherlands-only dedicated-Mac hoster with no US healthcare compliance program.

sso.note: No SAML/OIDC single sign-on mentioned in the User Management help article, security/privacy page, or Customer API docs; account/team access is portal-login based.

max_session_h.quote: A whole physical Mac of your own in the EU, with full root access, flat monthly pricing and support included.
max_session_h.note: Always-on dedicated machine (card modes: requires_always_on=true) billed monthly/hourly flat-rate; it runs until you stop/cancel it, no imposed session time limit.

snapshot.quote: The GMH Portal API gives you programmatic access to your servers, invoices, team members, and power controls.
snapshot.note: API paths are only /invoices, /services (+power, power-requests), /me/team, /tokens - no snapshot/image endpoint exists. Backups are the customer's own responsibility (Time Machine/Carbon Copy Cloner/Arq), not a provider snapshot product.

pause_resume.note: The only lifecycle controls exposed are reboot/power-on/power-off of a whole dedicated machine (billed always-on); there's no pause state with reduced/paused billing.

fork.quote: No, all our services are fully dedicated with no virtualisation involved. This means no noisy-neighbours: you can use the full bare metal power of the macOS server.
fork.note: Bare-metal dedicated Macs, no virtualization/imaging layer to clone from, and the API (invoices/services/power/team/tokens) has no clone/fork/image endpoint.

fork_running.quote: No, all our services are fully dedicated with no virtualisation involved.
fork_running.note: Same bare-metal reasoning as fork; no live-clone capability exists for a dedicated physical Mac.

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: The GMH Portal API gives you programmatic access to your servers, invoices, team members, and power controls.
memory_snapshot_fork.note: No memory-state capture/restore capability in the API or product pages; bare metal with no hypervisor to snapshot memory from.

computer_use.note: The customer API only exposes invoices/services/power/team/tokens - no screenshot+click driving API. Screen access is via ARD/VNC (documented in the help center) for a human, not an automation endpoint.

custom_image.quote: The GMH Portal API gives you programmatic access to your servers, invoices, team members, and power controls.
custom_image.note: No image/template concept anywhere in the product pages or API - you get a stock macOS install on bare metal and configure it yourself; there's no 'start from custom image' endpoint.

wake_on_request.quote: Hosted Mac servers Deployment within a few hours on most models
wake_on_request.note: Machines are always-on dedicated hosts billed by the month (no idle-triggered wake); the only lifecycle actions are manual remote power reboot/on/off via the portal or API.

auto_stop_idle.note: Power state changes are manual (reboot/power_on/power_off via API or portal); no idle-detection/auto-stop feature is documented, consistent with flat always-on monthly billing.

volumes.quote: Mac mini M4 - Base Apple Silicon M4 10-Core CPU / 10-Core GPU 16-32GB RAM 256GB SSD
volumes.note: Storage is a fixed internal SSD size baked into each machine config (256GB-8TB depending on model); no separate attachable/detachable network volume product is offered.

inbound_https.quote: Short answer: all of them, by default. Your Mac gets a public IP with no filtering at our network, except for a small set of ports known to be abused for DDoS attacks. What we don't restrict Any TCP port, any protocol... Run whatever you want: web servers, SSH, Xcode build farms, VPN endpoints, game servers, CI runners, custom protocols.
inbound_https.note: reviewed: proposed correction rejected (Every plan ships a public IPv4 with all TCP ports (including 443) open by default; you can run your own HTTPS server and reach it directly. This is self-managed (no managed HTTPS proxy/URL product) but the field is about reachability, which is confirmed. Card had this as false; correcting to true.)

agent_harnesses.quote: Full admin access Root login to your servers, install whatever you want
agent_harnesses.note: You get a bare macOS install with root and must install anything yourself; no coding-agent harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.) is preinstalled or offered as a template anywhere in the docs/portal.

gpu.quote: GPU dongle HDMI dongle included to enable better GPU performance
gpu.note: The only 'GPU' item is a free HDMI dongle that unlocks the Apple Silicon integrated GPU's full headless acceleration (a known macOS quirk) - not an offered discrete/add-on GPU compute product. Product is Apple-silicon Mac hosting, not a GPU cloud.

windows.quote: Mac mini server Mac Studio server Mac Cloud Mac Pro ... Want to host a Mac Pro or Mac Studio? An Intel based Mac? No problem.
windows.note: Entire product line is Apple Mac hardware (mini/Studio/Pro, Apple Silicon or legacy Intel); no Windows machines are offered.

self_host.quote: Dedicated server : rent a Mac mini from us. We are responsible for the hardware
self_host.note: Green Mini host is a hosting company that owns and racks the hardware for you; there is no software product you can deploy on your own infrastructure (colocation is the closest option, and that still means physically shipping hardware to their datacenter, not self-hosting their platform).

byoc.quote: Colocated server : bring or buy your own Mac mini, you own the hardware
byoc.note: Their 'bring your own hardware' option is colocation of physical Mac hardware in Green Mini host's own datacenter, not a managed software service deployed into a customer-owned cloud account (no cloud product exists at all).

open_source.quote: If you run an active FOSS project that needs macOS infrastructure for compiling, testing, or CI runners and pipelines, we can provide you with a dedicated Mac mini for free.
open_source.note: The 'Open Source Program' is free hardware donated to FOSS projects, not the core product (dedicated Mac hosting/portal) itself being released under an OSI license. No OSS license is named for the platform.

soc2.quote: We are compliant with industry standards such as ISO27001, and have regular external audits to prove and verify this to our customers and other stakeholders.
soc2.note: The dedicated Security and Privacy page lists ISO27001 as the compliance standard and names no other certification; no SOC 2 Type I/II attestation is mentioned anywhere on this page, the legal-documents list, or the products/compare pages.
